name: Is It Love? -Mystery Spell- Sebastian
source:
Archeology has always been one of your main interests. You love everything it englobes, the mysteries and legends around all the ancient civilizations. Wanting more than anything to be an Archeologist, you moved to Mystery Spell to study with the fields' most influential professor: The enigmatic Sebastian Jones.

Your parents don't approve of your choice, so you've been working as an au pair to pay for your tuition fees.  Your employers are pretty strange, but they don't scare you. You happen to have a mysterious gift yourself.

In this new story, you will leave Mystery Spell and set off on a journey, retracing the legendary Incas! Legends and romance will combine, making you fall undoubtedly under Sebastian Jones' spell. But can this forbidden teacher/student love, really last…?

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=net.isitlove.mysteryspell.sebastian]Google Play[/url]]
translation:
考古一直是你的主要興趣之一。你熱愛古代文明的一切，包括其中的神秘與傳說。為了成為考古學家，你搬到神秘法術鎮，向該領域最有影響力的教授、神秘的賽巴斯汀．瓊斯學習。

你的父母不贊成你的選擇，因此你做互惠生來支付學費。僱主一家十分古怪，卻並不令你害怕，因為你自己也擁有神秘的天賦。

在這個新故事中，你將離開神秘法術鎮，踏上重尋印加傳說的旅程。傳說與浪漫交織，讓你不可避免地陷入賽巴斯汀．瓊斯的魅力。但這段禁忌的師生戀真的能長久嗎……？

[來源：[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=net.isitlove.mysteryspell.sebastian]Google Play[/url]]
